summary: Learn to design executive dashboards and decision briefs with KPI trees, IBCS visuals, and Power BI workflows. Enrol now.
lede: Executive dashboard and decision briefing work helps reporting professionals turn KPI data into concise, decision-ready updates for senior leaders. You’ll practice selecting leading and lagging indicators, interpreting variances and escalation signals, planning dashboard layouts, and writing briefings that connect performance and risk to action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already produce or consume management information and now need to make it decision-ready for senior leadership. It suits people who work with KPIs, performance packs, dashboards, and briefing notes across finance, operations, strategy, and reporting functions.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites: working knowledge of business reporting, KPI concepts, and spreadsheet-based analysis; familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar reporting tools is helpful. No coding is required. Participants should bring a laptop and, where possible, a sample dashboard, management report, or KPI pack from their own work for workshop use. Advanced concepts such as dashboard governance and executive narrative design are taught at an operational application level, not as software engineering or data architecture.
